ability.name: Grandiose Fuselage

ability.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+) against damage inflicted by shoot abilities.

ability.name: Nullstone Galvanisation
ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each enemy **^^Manifestation^^** within this unit's combat range.

ability.name: Gruksson Wide-Bore Cylinders
ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic.

ability.name: Tracer-Fire Rounds

ability.name: Voidstone Repulser Vents
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• Ignore the effect of that spell on that friendly unit.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but you can only roll once for each friendly unit per spell cast.

ability.name: Zonbarcorp 'Dealbreaker' Battle Ram
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

ability.name: Blazebeard and Sons Ejector Pod
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendlt **^^Kharadron Overlords Hero^^** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
